records.name: North Road
records.description: Route from Tallowmere's North Gate through outer farms toward Ashcombe Manor and the Northfields.

records.name: River Vale Road
records.description: Western route following the River Vale through Millhaven toward Fordmere.

records.name: Western Track
records.description: Rough branch toward Brackenholt and managed woodland, most reliable in dry conditions.

records.name: Quarry Road
records.description: Southwestern branch built for stone carts climbing toward Stonehollow and the Greyback Ridges.

records.name: Eastern Shore Road
records.description: Coastal route southeast to Saltwick and smaller shore landings.

records.name: King's Road / South Road
records.description: Southern route from Tallowmere toward Harthbridge and the fragmented southern jurisdictions.
